Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

cleanresults 0.1.0

First public release.

Tables

  • clean_regress() fits linear, logistic, Poisson, negative binomial, ordinal, and Bayesian (brms) models for one or several outcomes, with mixed-model versions when random is given.
  • Robust standard errors by default (HC3; CR2 with Satterthwaite df for clustered and mixed models), explicit reference-category rows, pairwise contrasts (emmeans) corrected within each factor, and an optional correction across outcomes. Each table carries an automatic methods note.
  • cr_table() and cr_contrast_table() render in Quarto (HTML, Word, PDF) and export with cr_save() to Word, LaTeX, HTML, and CSV. Styles: "apa", "stargazer", "compact".
  • Baseline adjustment (ANCOVA, Lin 2013), simple effects (contrast_by), and equivalence tests (cr_equivalence()).

Results text and checks

  • cr_inline(), cr_direction(), cr_sig(), cr_sentence(), and cr_report() build results prose from the fitted objects.
  • cr_hypotheses() / cr_h() map hypotheses to tests and robustness checks; cr_expect() fails a render when a claim stops being true.
  • cr_verify() checks numbers typed in a .qmd, .Rmd, or .docx against the results; cr_ground_truth() and cr_diff() report what changed between runs, flagging sign flips and significance changes.
  • Simple tests with effect sizes: cr_d(), cr_ttest(), cr_chisq(), cr_anova(), cr_cor().

Figures

  • cr_plot_means(), cr_plot_interaction(), cr_plot_coef(), and cr_plot_hist() return ordinary ggplot objects, with theme_cr(), colour-vision-checked palettes, and cr_save() export at journal widths.

Other

  • cr_example_data() provides simulated data for the documentation.
